messages:
maya: Heads-up: webinar next Wed. Need owners on reg page, Zoom setup, recording backup, post emails + tagging. Short checklist?
tony: I’ll run Zoom ops. Plan: cloud recording ON, live transcript ON, record separate audio tracks, cohosts: harper,sam, preassign breakout CSV, require passcode + waiting room, disable participant screen share. Test Tue 09:00 PT. Will export VTT after event.
harper: Reg page + HubSpot mapping. Fields: first,last,email,company,role,team_size (dropdown), use_case (free text). Hidden: utm_campaign, utm_source. GDPR opt-in checkbox (not prechecked). Confirmation email: replay placeholder (we’ll swap link when processed), slides link, calendar .ics, CTA: Request a demo. Mapping: set property webinar_apr=true; lifecycle=MQL if team_size>50 OR role in [Eng,Product,Platform].
sam: Post-event plan: attendees -> email 1h after with recording + slides + 1-click book-demo. Registrants no-show -> email 3h after with highlights + 1Q survey. High-engagers (watch_pct>60%) -> tag webinar_apr_hot and assign to SDR queue with transcript link. Tag all contacts with utm_source. I’ll build HubSpot workflows + Outreach sequence and wire engagement webhook.
ops-bot: meeting 1804109000 created "Panel: Inference tradeoffs" scheduled 2026-04-15 17:00 UTC  cloud_recording=on, live_transcript=on, passcode=required.
maya: Action items recap: tony test Tue 09:00 PT + export VTT; harper reg page + confirmation copy + slide upload link; sam post-event flows + tagging; I’ll schedule rehearsal and drop runbook link. Thanks!
